sentences.en: Ybreska vaulted over the low, crumbling wall surrounding the old churchyard on to the rough pitted track which led towards Tbilisi.

sentences.en: Sigua was reported to have fled to the rebel headquarters in a Komsomol summer camp outside Tbilisi to avoid arrest.

sentences.en: There were reports of opposition supporters having been fired on in Tbilisi the following day.

sentences.en: Kirov chose another snap which he had taken at a pavement cafe in Tbilisi, bringing his final selection to four.
